entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to an agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Diana. How can I help you today?
I need to start a return. My order number is 881-C45-301.
Okay, I can certainly help with that. Let me just pull up that order... 881-C45-301. I see the VeloPro cycling shoes. Is that correct?
Yes. Look, I just want to know if I can return them. Yes or no?
I understand. Just so I can note it down for the return reason, could you tell me what the issue was? Was it a defect or...?
No defect. I set up the cleats perfectly, went on one ride, and got horrible blisters. The fit is all wrong. I need a refund.

I'm very sorry to hear that, and I appreciate the clarification. Let me check the delivery date for you. I see they were delivered 66 days ago. You are well within our 90-day return window for these shoes.

Absolutely. I have just initiated the return process for you. You will receive an email in the next few minutes with a prepaid shipping label and instructions. Once we receive the cycling shoes back at our warehouse, we will issue your full refund to the original payment method.
Okay. I just got the email. That's all I needed. Thanks.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
